findings.explanation: The tests for the main criterion are hollow. test_under_limit only checks the result is a bool. test_exactly_at_limit_is_allowed asserts the result is in (True, False), which always passes. test_over_limit only checks the result is not None. None of them check the allowed or denied outcome. The inclusive boundary (spent_today + amount == limit returns True) is untested, so changing <= to < would still pass. Replace them with assertTrue for under-limit and exact-limit, and assertFalse for over-limit (e.g. 950+100 > 1000, and one cent over the limit).
